question: What name and concluding address frame the teaching given to Sāmba?
premises: The teaching is addressed to Sāmba.
It is declared as told to him.
It is named as bringing auspiciousness to the three worlds.
inference: The teaching concluded to Sāmba is called the auspiciousness of the three worlds.
plain_english: Thus, O Sāmba, this teaching called the auspiciousness of the three worlds has been told to you.
